policy_presence.summary: No accepted current canonical conclusion is established here; local evidence candidates and original tool records remain pending review.

ai_disclosure.summary: Permitted examination AI use must be labelled and documented under the relevant instructions.

coursework.summary: Coursework AI use depends on the particular course and assessment instructions; check permission before submitting.

exams.summary: Exam boards determine whether AI aids may be allowed; examiners specify the permitted tools and uses. Disclosure alone does not authorize an unapproved aid.

privacy_data_entry.summary: The teaching framework prohibits uploading personal or copyrighted content to AI systems. KI.Assist terms separately prohibit processing personal or identifiable data and limit use to university purposes.

academic_integrity.summary: Unapproved AI use in examinations may be treated as unauthorized aid, including when disclosed; allegations require applicable procedure.

approved_tools.summary: KI.Assist@FU is a university-provided tool via FU Account SSO; tool access does not confer assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: No accepted current canonical conclusion is established here; local evidence candidates and original tool records remain pending review.

teaching_guidance.summary: Exam boards decide whether AI aids may be permitted; examiners specify and communicate permitted tools and uses. This is not blanket classroom authorization.

research_guidance.summary: No university-wide research or publishing permission can be concluded from the teaching-oriented framework; verify applicable research rules.

security_procurement.summary: KI.Assist@FU terms restrict processing personal information and evaluating student work; procurement approval and retention guarantees require separate checks.
